title: Orbit atlas
description: An open image archive can be panned, fitted, zoomed and brought into focus one work at a time.
useCase: Explore a spatial collection and inspect an item without losing its surrounding arrangement.
interaction: Drag the canvas, zoom or choose a work.

reducedMotion: The camera moves immediately between views; all pan, zoom and selection controls remain.
limitations: Six works in a bounded board. It intentionally does not create an infinite or automatically populated canvas.
look: Off-white board holding six white-bordered prints (woodblock landscapes, a fern cyanotype, sepia photographs) loosely arranged above a floating white zoom toolbar.
motion: Clicking a work glides the board to centre and enlarge it over 0.32 s ease-out; dragging pans 1:1 without easing, and the zoom and fit buttons animate the same transform.
adapt: The camera is `view` (x, y, zoom) applied to `oa-world` as translate plus scale with a 0.32 s `cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)` transition; `focus`, `fit` and `bounded` set targets and limits. Replace `specimens` positions and images with your own layout.
